tabs.p0: Visual treatment for the tab list.
tabs.p1: Color treatment for the selected tab.
tabs.p2: Controlled active tab value. Takes precedence over selectedIndex.
tabs.p3: Called when the active tab changes.
tabs.p5: Called with the new index when the active tab changes.
tabs.p6: Default active tab for uncontrolled usage.
tabs.l0: Whether arrow-key focus also selects a tab.
tabs.l1: For pill, segment, and underline tabs: show every icon label, or only the selected tab's label. Requires icons to collapse labels.
tabs.l2: Additional CSS classes for the container.
tabs.i3: Optional count, status, Badge element, or Badge props object. Use '{ children, color, variant }' for Badge colors and dot status.
tabs.n1: Panel content, rendered when the matching tab is active.
